Tamil Nadu Allocates Funds for Urban Livelihood Mission and Infrastructure

The Tamil Nadu government has released Rs 10.7 crore to ensure the continued operation of its urban livelihood mission. Separately, the state announced plans to invest ₹1.50 Lakh Crore in urban infrastructure over the next five years.
